queries.text: "morte dos detalhes" → "death of details" and "lei de recorrência" → "law of recurrence" (Gnostic terms from Samael Aun Weor, as usually rendered in English). Alternative for the first: "death of the small details."
"ginásio psicológico" → "psychological gymnasium" (Samael Aun Weor's term for daily life as a field for self-observation, as usually rendered in English).
